title: Extension of a surjective integral morphism from an open
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $U\subseteq S$ be open [def-weil-open-immersion], and let $V\to U$ be a surjective integral morphism [def-weil-surjective-morphism, def-weil-finite-integral-morphism]. Then there exists a surjective integral morphism $\overline V\to S$ such that $\overline V\times_S U$ is isomorphic to $V$ over $U$.

mathlib_searches.query: A surjective integral morphism over an open subscheme extends to a surjective integral morphism over the whole scheme with the same restriction
Extend a surjective integral morphism from an open subscheme to the whole scheme
mathlib_searches.results: IsIntegralHom.hasAffineProperty; Surjective.mk; no normalization extension statement.
normalization declarations occur, but no extension theorem for a surjective integral morphism.

from.place: The extension step in Tag 0CNZ: extend each surjective integral map over an open subscheme to the whole base.
